thesis: The podcast discusses the state of AI in April 2024, focusing on how average content creation limits value and questioning whether big tech's compute and data advantages are sufficient to drown out new startups. The speakers debate whether founders should assume foundation models will improve 100 times better and explore if proprietary data is the new oil, while also addressing the venture capital model's need to refresh for the current rate of change.
